text:
message: For in the word of the Lord it is written in Philippians 4:6-7 Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
reply: 📖 Philippians 4:6-7: Amen! 🙏
